نجنن (form I)
# نَجْنُنْ (najnun) /nad͡ʒ.nun/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of جَنَّ (janna)
# نُجْنَنْ (nujnan) /nud͡ʒ.nan/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
